description: Find UAE restaurants, cafés and other venues near an area or landmark (e.g. "Burj Khalifa", "Dubai Marina", "Yas Island") that fit a cuisine, a budget per person and must-haves such as alcohol, kids or outdoor seating. Each venue says which asks are confirmed and which are not known, with price per person, rating, photos, any live Discond deal and a link. A whole emirate is too wide: the result then names what is missing.

adults.description: Number of adults in the group.

kids.description: Number of children. More than 0 also asks for kid-friendly venues.

kind.description: dining (restaurants and cafés, default) or any venue type

lat.description: Latitude to search around (with lng). Overrides place.

limit.description: How many venues to return (1–10, default 6).

must_have.description: Requirements: a venue that is known not to meet one is left out

place.description: Area or landmark, e.g. "Burj Khalifa", "Downtown Dubai", "JBR", "Dubai Mall". lat/lng overrides.

radius_m.description: Search radius in meters (default: the area size, about 1.5 km)

name: discond_find_venues
title: Find venues
